gizmo.title: Tauwhāiti peka
gizmo.description: He kōrero e arahina ai ia kōwhiringa ki tētahi whakaaturanga me tētahi mutunga rerekē. Ka taea e ngā ākonga te hoki whakamuri ka whakamātau i ētahi atu ara; mā te mutunga i tae atu ai e whakatau te kaute.

configure.title: Taitara
configure.description: Te ingoa o te tauwhāiti, ka whakaaturia ki tōna pane.

configure.title: Whakaaturanga tīmatanga
configure.description: Te ID o te whakaaturanga e tīmata ai ngā ākonga. Waiho kia wātea hei tīmata i te whakaaturanga tuatahi.

advanced.title: Tae arotahi
advanced.description: He tae kōwhiri mō te maramara pane, ngā pātene me te tapa o tētahi kōwhiringa.
